notes.content:

notes.title: Random Enemy Mode in the Making
notes.content:
[h3]Dear combo lovers,

Thank you so much for the support! I've received dozens of feedback from the previous survey and I'm going to consider every one of your suggestions for my future updates!

If you haven't shared your ideas yet, take a look [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2054770/view/4258798098389053674?l=english]here[/url] (chance to win Steam gift cards too!)

So far I'm working on a few things:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new random enemies mode where all the enemies attacks and abilities will be randomized to make every encounter feel different
[*] Ascension levels will be shared between heroes, but you will still be able to adjust your level
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
[h3]I am looking forward to making the game better with all of you! Hope you are too!

Cam
[/h3]

notes.title: Combo Raid Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Combo lovers![/h3]

🔊Combo Card Clashers is back with a major update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632282/c896fb4d91689560a89d8995a7c2e183d50a9e6b.jpg[/img]

🥁This "Combo Raid" update allows you to play bigger combos, and faster!

[i]🤑The game will be 20% OFF in the upcoming summer sale (June 27 - July 11) - wishlist the game to receive notification![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2054770/Combo_Card_Clashers/

[h3]📍Major Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Game Mode: Energy Mode![/b] You can play multiple cards in one turn - combos take form much faster this way. Tell me which mode you prefer!
[*] [b]New Crusader Hero with Blood Eagle companion![/b] Crusader gains mana by playing physical attacks - arrange your grid that works towards a tight-fit physical + magical combo!
[*] 5 New Cards & 6 New Artifacts
[*] 1 New Event
[*] 6 New Achievements
[/list]

[h3]📍Bugs Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressing “Continue” repeatedly loads the game many times
[*] Pressing Next on story shows loading bar many times
[*] Save game after a boss will now save if you didn't move around in the next world
[*] Quotations fixed in most story/events
[*] Fixed Chaotic Flask, Chained Magic not having sounds sfx dampened by adjusting volume
[*] Fixed gold can be negative
[*] Fixed unit not giving death animation when dying from 1-2hp damage
[*] Fixed Reroll gear/card not having increased cost with each attempt
[/list]

[h3]📍Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Artifact bar can be collapsed now so artifacts don't cover the UI
[*] Improved End of Run EXP gain (more improvements coming later)
[*] Lesser Heal (Healing Spells in general) is now affected by demon gloves
[*] Bear Lifesteal ability -> 5->8%
[*] Scroll speed increased on talent tree and world map
[*] UI perspective shift on some menus to improve UI
[*] UI window pop up animations improved a bit
[/list]

🧵Don't hesitate to tell me what you think of the updated content! Your reviews and feedback will help steer the game's development in the future!

Cam

notes.title: Combo Card Clashers OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h3]Dear combo lovers,
[/h3]

[h3]🔥I'm happy to announce that Combo Card Clashers is OUT NOW!

Thanks a lot for all the support and feedback along the way! You helped make the game better - I hope you enjoy the full game!

notes.content:
[h3]Hi guys,

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2054770/

[i]He crash landed from space on a mission to study this medieval planet.
Unique skill - [b]Alien Focus[/b]: all cards use focus instead of mana.
Unique combo grid - alien has larger size of rows on his combo grid and advantages/disadvantages to certain grid spaces.
Build massive combos with Alien Focus![/i]

[/h3]

notes.title: Update v0.92 Early Game Upgrade
notes.content:
[b][u]Patch Notes v0.92[/u][/b]

Hey everyone,

Demo v0.92 has been released! It mainly focuses on changing the early game a little bit. To do that, I added 2 more starting cards to each character's deck. Also, there are a few new enemy encounters, and some enemies have special abilities. Additionally there are some small graphic changes, and many other changes! See below for list:

[b]Cards:[/b]
-Added 2 additional cards to player start deck (7 total now)
-Added 1 new card for the mage’s starting deck
-Locked and Confused cards now have new descriptions
-Cards now ease-in/out when hovering over and the buttons do not

[b]Tutorial:[/b]
-New step to show enemy status effects

[b] Enemies:[/b]
-World 1 enemies have been revised with some getting special abilities, and a few new encounters added.
-New Skeleton enemy. 

[b]Recruits:[/b]
-5 new recruit abilities added

[b]Map:[/b]
Map objects now ease-in/out if you hover over them

[b]Story:[/b]
Story page layout has been changed, and text has been changed to a type writer similar to the tutorial.

[b]Shops:[/b]
-Shop gfx updated to make shopkeepers less blurry (also character select had same update too)
-card upgrade FX has been updated as well

[b]Events:[/b]
Event page gfx has been updated to look better.

If you're a fan of the game, remember to join the discord so you can give feedback for me to improve the game! 

Thanks and enjoy!!

notes.title: Demo v0.5 BIG UI and Talent Tree Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Thanks for reading my update. The main focus of this update was to create a talent tree for meta progression, and to work on the UI. The talent tree features 45 unique talents to learn. The Combat UI has been completely redone including the combo grid and all the rewards. New enemies were added, including a new 2nd World Boss!  

-If you want to get the extended demo, please join the Discord and ask for the code. That will allow you to fight the 2nd boss, and see the beginning of world 3!

Download the Demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2054770/Combo_Card_Clashers/

[h1]Patch Notes (Demo v0.5)[/h1]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[h3]Meta Progression Talent Tree[/h3]
[list]
[*] added 3 separate skill trees (Combat, Magic, and Leadership)
[*] Each tree has 15 different talents
[*] 1 talent from each tree is unlockable in the demo
[*] You earn talent points by completing the demo (if you earn enough EXP)
[/list]

[h3]World[/h3]
[list]
[*] World Map #3 added
[*] Warrior story for world 3 added
[*] Mage story for world 3 added
[/list]

[h3]New Enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*] “New World 2 Boss”: (only available in extended demo) 
[*] “Champion Soldier”: An enemy who deals more dmg the more health he is missing, has single target attack, and cleave attack
[*] “Demon Monk”: Has a passive barrier, a poison spray attack, and an attack up buff
[/list]

[h3]New UI:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Combat scene UI completely redone
[*] 	New art for: combo grid, buttons, rewards windows, health and mana bars etc.
[*] Debuffs under them are now under the health and mana bar instead of below the enemy
[/list]

[h3]Shops Rework:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spell Shop offers 4 cards instead of 3
[*] Now sells 4 random artifacts
[*] Layout has been changed
[*] Minimum card cost is now 100
[*] Weapon Shop now sells 4 random artifacts
[*] Layout has been changed
[/list]

[h3]Barrier Mechanic:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added in a barrier mechanic that blocks a set amount of damage. If not 0, it continues into the next round.
[*] Some barriers refresh each round
[/list]

[h3]Barrier Card[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a barrier card for players (gives a barrier that blocks up to 10 damage and lasts 3 rounds)
[/list]

[h3]Number indicator [/h3]
[list]
[*] for debuffs that have a set duration (ex: sleeping enemies, or… certain bosses)
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]

[h3]Cards:[/h3]
[list]
[*] rebalanced starting mage spells 
[*] -”Fireball” reduced mana cost by 5
[*] -”Lightning” reduced mana cost by 5
[*] Cards that block damage have been buffed to block more damage
[*] “Immolation” now gives dmg resist
[*] “Dark prism” also adds damage for each debuff on the enemy
[*] “Hone skill” mana cost dcr by 10
[/list]

[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*] “Summoner Sword” Enemy hp increased by 75 and damage incr by 5
[*] “Imp” now has 50 less hp, and reduced status resistance
[*] “Golem” is now weaker, and comes with 2 instead of one.
[*] “Pipe of friendship” bonus decreased from 25% to 15%
[*] “Poisonous Shroom” now gives +2 poison at start instead of +1
[*] Some enemy attacks have been modified for when theyre recruited on your team. Ex: Satyr and Bear (so their damage doesn't scale out of control)
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upper weapon range damage decreased by 2
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
Couldnt move gear if you tried to sell it previously 

[h3]Demo Restrictions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Demo now has restricted progress. Cannot go past 75% of world 2 unless you have the Extended Demo Code found in the discord channel
[*] Cards unlocked, deckbuilding cards, and artifacts limit is restricted unless you have the Extended Demo Code found in the discord channel
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.4 Major Game Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Sorry its been so long with holidays etc. Here is the next update though :) Tons of changes I am sure you will enjoy. The demo is longer now, and there are more new monsters to defeat! The map gives more opportunities too, and there is a lot of beautiful new artwork to see and game choices to make! Enjoy and see you next update! 

Patch Notes

Big Changes
-Hex tiles have been rotated so player has 3 movement choices instead of 2 when on world map
-Events page redesigned to look like Story Page
-New artwork for all Events
-World map compass removed, and now all sites have tooltips
-Cards now have sub tooltips to explain any additional information (such as buffs/debuffs/discard after play/ etc)
-Enemy damage is less by ⅓ the first 3 rounds of combat
-Combat UI revised (smaller for more space)
-Position of Hero, Allies, Enemies adjusted
-Length before end of demo has been extended to right before end of world map 2

-4 new encounters have been created in the 2nd world map 
[list]
[*] Treant and Werewolves
[*] Zombie Bear 
[*] 3 Spirits
[*] Demon Imps
[/list]
-4 new events created
[list]
[*] Fallen Gladiator
[*] Gobline Carnival 
[*] Demonic Encounter
[*] Possessed Skull
[/list]
-8 new cards
[list]
[*] Single target stun
[*] Multi target stun
[*] Repeat Column
[*] Repeated Strike
[*] Block Fixed Damage
[*] Exploding Corpse
[*] Ice Blast
[*] Upgrade Next Card
[/list]
-4 new artifacts created
[list]
[*] 3% dmg reduction
[*] 40% chance to not discard a (discard after play) card
[*] +10 gold for each space traveled in map
[*] all enemies start with 1 poisoned (except sleeping units)
[/list]
-New Art:
[list]
[*] Mage Hero 
[*] Recruited Companions
[*] Summons (Skeleton and Skeleton Mage)
[*] Enemies World 1 (Snake and Witchdoctor, Golem, Satyr, Slime King, Illusion Boss)
[/list]

Small Changes
-Card Viewer now shows 4 cards per row instead of 3
-Weapon modifiers (ex: 3% chance to cast a spell, lifesteal etc.) now work for Allies/Recruited Enemies

notes.title: Demo v0.35 Big Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Big Features[/h1]
[b]New World Map![/b]
	-includes all new tiles for each location (enemy encounter, weapon shop, spell shop, etc.)
	-includes new terrain tiles
	-includes new foliage (trees)
	-have alternate maps for world map 1 and 2
	-new player icon on map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632282/142cf38d62df8bac23d6e90937128a6ae1b0e48e.png[/img]

[b]Allies (including Monsters) can now level up![/b]
	-each level they gain +4 all attributes
	-on levels 2 and 3 they gain upgraded skills (not monsters only hired allies)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632282/628ded3b1a8cd62616ba77ed61fffbfedcb1da1c.png[/img]

[b]All allies in inventory can use Weapons/Armor![/b]
	-this includes monsters too
	-stats for allies and monsters are shown in your inventory (just like the player)
[b]You can resurrect fallen allies in the recruit shop![/b]
	-includes allies/monsters. 150 for a monster and 200 for an ally. Price Increases in each world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632282/e3c3b9ad9ca2bbfe096d7ee17e4a854df79afbb4.png[/img]

[b]You can kick allies from your party[/b]
        -open inventory and select the kick icon on the unit
[b]You can now sell gear at the weapon shop[/b]
	-sell price is 50% of the bought price
[b]You can now Reroll gear in the shop.[/b]
	-generates three new gears. Price of reroll increases with each use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632282/b7764467e56036c304758ff3346f9ec8bfd74d7d.png[/img]

[b]Inventory space is now infinite![/b]
         -you can hold as much gear as you want
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632282/8dfadcabdef929957de23ef7d36537d4762740b1.png[/img]

[b]-Mage hero imported into combat scene! (Before it was the warrior as a placeholder)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632282/6907643bebd854ba1e8c54a298fb68677f0b3e5d.png[/img]

[h2]Other Features[/h2]
-Shows pictures on side of inventory window of your current allies
	-you can click on their picture to see individual stats of allies
-In world map shows pictures of allies in your group and monsters.
	-for example if you have a slime monster in your party, it will show a slime icon
[h2]QOL[/h2]
-New more zoomed out combat bkg 
-Pictures of group members moved to bottom of screen in world map (QOL)
-Ally is shown when bought in the bottom bar and when you find them after combat (QOL)
-Shows Ally EXP on the bottom bar
-now shows ally HP on the tooltip (so you know when you recruit them how much HP they have)
-Inventory blocks enemy/ally tooltips behind it. For example when you open inventory in combat zone.
-Player move speed on world map is now 2x
-Tutorial been updated to include new images and split modifiers from swapping tiles

[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
-fixed going over 4 allies and illusionist going over 4 illusions
-fixed hurt / death animations for enemies 1-4 (rat, slime , rat mage, boar, totem summoner, totem)
-shop doesnt restrict you from buying gear if inventory is full. It will add it to stash now
-fixed blood necklace artifact not dealing double damage on CRIT 

[h2]Balance[/h2]
-wisdom now increases allies hp by 15 instead of 10
-When you take more wisdom stats from leveling up or gear your allies instantly gain the extra benefit hp change (before it wouldn't update after the ally or monster joins group)
-Small Rat, and Rat Mage HP decreased by 10
-Attack damage increased for some later enemies
-reduced how fast weapon damage scales with the player level (was 3*player lv, now 2*player level)
